probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim target As Workbook, part As Object
Dim sourceText As String
Application.EnableEvents = False
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Set target = Workbooks.Add
Set part = target.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
part.Name = "Records"
sourceText = sourceText & "Public Type RecordData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Value As Long" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Values(0 To 1) As Long" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Type" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Private Stored() As RecordData" & vbCrLf

sourceText = sourceText & "Private Replacement As RecordData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Public Sub ReplaceCell(ByRef number As Long)" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Stored(1) = Replacement" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "number = number + 10" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Public Sub FailBorrow(ByRef number As Long)" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "number = number + 10" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Err.Raise 5" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Public Sub Bump(ByRef number As Long)" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "number = number + 10" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Sub" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Public Sub Borrow(ByRef number As Long)" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "ReDim Preserve Stored(0 To 2)" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Failure = Err.Number" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "number = number + 10" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Sub" & vbCrLf

sourceText = sourceText & "Dim items(0 To 1) As RecordData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "items(0).Value = 5" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Check = CStr(items(1).Value)" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Function" & vbCrLf

End Function
